quote: By exercise 2.5.41 we have that the subgroup generated by $b$ is normal
reason: The cited exercise is not supplied, so its applicability cannot be verified. The assertion itself is true by Sylow: the number of Sylow 7-subgroups divides 3 and is congruent to 1 modulo 7, hence is 1. Conditional on normality, $aba^{-1}\in\langle b\rangle$, so $aba^{-1}=b^i$ for some $i\in\{0,\ldots,6\}$.
